world_app_description: A WLD or USDC plan for someone you love.
description_overview: Make a WLD or USDC plan for someone you love. Choose an heir and a renewal period, create a personal vault, and keep its countdown renewed. Manage separate vaults together; each has its own asset, heir and timer. The basic WLD vault has no platform fee. WLD yield is optional; USDC uses Re7 USDC on Morpho with explicit risk consent. Yield exits charge 10% of realized positive net gains after underlying fees and loss recovery, without a principal or management fee. USDC gains and actually claimed WLD rewards are charged separately, with no conversion or cross-currency loss offset. Returns vary, principal can lose value, and cash withdrawals depend on liquidity. After expiry the named heir can file a claim, starting a fixed seven-day review. Monitored new vaults can then transfer automatically to the fixed heir. You can renew to cancel the claim until transfer executes. Yield inheritance may pay receipt shares; held WLD goes to the same heir. This is a smart-contract transfer plan, not a legal will.
description_how_it_works:
1. Sign in with World App wallet authentication. World ID verification is not required.
2. Choose WLD or USDC. WLD offers basic custody or a separate optional Morpho yield vault. USDC defaults to Morpho, with explicit consent to its fee, loss and receipt-inheritance terms. Existing funds never move automatically; each vault has its own heir, balance and timer.
3. Name a contact, username or wallet address and choose 1 to 365 days. Create the vault, then approve and deposit its selected asset. Tell your heir through World Chat or a shared link. Reminders are optional; each recipient needs their own notification permission.
4. Renew before your countdown ends. After expiry the named heir can file a claim and wait seven days. Funds remain in the vault or its strategy during review. You can renew until transfer actually executes.
5. After review, monitored new vaults can transfer automatically. The heir can also complete eligible inheritance in World App; earlier basic vaults require manual completion. Network, funding and service delays can affect timing.
6. Yield inheritance first tries cash redemption. If that fails, receipt shares and idle cash go to the fixed heir; any quoted positive-gain fee is paid in shares. The heir can later redeem wallet-held shares as liquidity permits without a second service fee.
7. WLD yield vaults can claim and reinvest WLD rewards without increasing principal or resetting the timer. USDC vaults instead hold claimed WLD separately, with no swap or USDC reinvestment. Its 10% WLD reward fee applies when rewards are withdrawn or paid at inheritance; WLD gifts are excluded. USDC gains are charged after USDC loss recovery and do not offset WLD fees.
8. Late canonical WLD rewards belong to the original fixed inheritance recipient, including after the owner releases the old slot or creates a replacement. Keep the original vault link.

Underlying fees, governance and risks can change. USDC can depeg or be frozen by its issuer. Campaign rewards vary; World App's verified-human boost is not automatic for a personal vault contract. There is no fixed APY or guarantee of principal. Network transaction fees may apply.
description_connect: Our server verifies a one-use World App wallet signature and issues a one-hour wallet-bound session. User-approved WLD, USDC, factory and Re7 receipt-token transactions run on World Chain. User private keys and seed phrases are never collected. The monitoring service stores registered addresses, vault state, alert history and gas execution records; short-lived security records protect sign-in and API access. A dedicated infrastructure signer pays network gas only for an eligible transfer to the contract's fixed heir. It cannot file the heir's claim, redirect funds or withdraw an active owner's balance. Each yield factory's strategy, service fee and fee recipient are fixed at deployment; our contracts have no admin, upgrade or strategy-switch permissions. The underlying Morpho vaults have their own curator and governance risks. No independent third-party security audit has been performed. Read the Privacy Policy, Terms and Yield Terms in the app.
